$comment: Single source of truth for the Tabs API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switch between related views without leaving the page.

value / defaultValue.description: The open tab (controlled or not). Use onValueChange to hear about changes.

TabList aria-label.description: Names the group of tabs for screen readers.

Tab / TabPanel value.description: Links each tab to its panel.

examples.title: Segmented
examples.description: The default look. Arrow keys move between tabs. In HTML, add data-vin-tabs and include vinui.js once.

examples.title: Line
examples.description: Underlined tabs for page sections and settings screens.

a11y: Follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: role="tablist", "tab" and "tabpanel", linked with aria-controls and aria-labelledby.
Only the open tab is in the Tab order; ← → move between tabs and Home/End jump to the first or last. Right-to-left layouts flip the arrows.
Panels can take focus, so keyboard users reach their content straight after the tabs.
The open tab is shown by more than colour: a raised surface or an underline.
